evidence.snippet: the therapeutic benefits of thiamin for Wernicke-Korsakoff syndrome and beriberi were demonstrated.
evidence.explanation: Historical/review narrative (Handbook of Clinical Neurology), not a primary clinical study, hence evidence_source OTHER. Thiamine is a replacement therapy whose mode of action is vitamin repletion. The assigned disease node is Avitaminosis (MESH:D001361); thiamine treats specifically the thiamine-deficiency avitaminoses (beriberi, Wernicke-Korsakoff syndrome), a subtype of avitaminosis, and cannot be narrowed further because the curated (drug, disease) pair fixes MESH:D001361. No downstream molecular mechanism distinct from replacement of the depleted vitamin can be sourced for this indication.
